acknowledged.reason: The per-event bounded least-squares fits stop at a point that depends on rounding in the installed NumPy and SciPy. Under the isolated-transit geometry the scan values reproduce to about 0.3 in delta chi-square; single grid points under the Cochran et al. geometry move by up to 10. See 'How closely a rerun matches' in the README.

Same solver sensitivity as replay.py. Single grid points under the stronger limb-darkening law move by up to 6 in delta chi-square. The largest value all seven fits reach at a common grid point stays 15.19. See 'How closely a rerun matches' in the README.

The direct refit chooses among five starts per event and has nearby local minima. Summed delta chi-square reproduces to about 0.1; fitted timing offsets and per-event values near zero move by more. See 'How closely a rerun matches' in the README.

The generator is seeded; the residuals it shuffles come from the same solver-dependent fits. Scores move by less than 0.001 and the recovered counts (1,999, 638 and 0 of 2,000) do not change. See 'How closely a rerun matches' in the README.
